name: faceted-swallow
description: The swallow as a faceted sculpture on Daylight, centred.
prompt: A single swallow in flight with its wings fully spread, rendered as a faceted low-poly sculpture in deep navy, electric blue and luminous cyan, centred on a pale daylight background with a soft contact shadow below it. Elegant, minimal, museum-object lighting. Colour palette strictly limited to deep navy #121B2A, electric blue #1B56FF, luminous cyan #00D5FF and pale daylight #F4F7FB, with their in-between shades. Premium, calm editorial brand imagery with generous negative space and soft light from the upper left. No text, letters, numbers, logos, people, robots, circuit patterns, sparkles, purple or pink.
